description: Estimate what a Delta Air Lines ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

card.description: Paying with a Delta Amex card. none = No; BL = Blue; GO = Gold; PL = Platinum; RE = Reserve.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Delta Air Lines's own: flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare type. CR = Classic (or Refundable); EX = Extra; PB = Basic (Comfort, First, Premium Select, One); BA = Main Basic (Basic Economy). Delta Comfort, First, Premium Select and Delta One earn as Classic or Extra, whichever you bought. Their Basic fares earn as Basic.

price.description: Ticket price in US dollars. Base fare plus carrier charges, without government taxes and fees (shown on your receipt). Required unless creditTo is given.

status.description: Your Medallion status. none = None; FO = Silver; GM = Gold; PM = Platinum; DM = Diamond.

name: calculate_delta_miles
title: Delta SkyMiles Calculator
